notes: All 4 photos are the same three chalkboards (Daily Breads, Granola/Bread Plates and More, Sandwiches) photographed on different visits with slightly different prices as the boards were updated over time; used photo 4 (sharpest, most complete) as the price source. Sandwich prices are listed Half/Whole on the board; 'price' holds the half price and the whole price is repeated in description. Skipped single-item bread-plate add-ons (butter/jam/cheese portions) as modifiers, and skipped the 'Assorted Mini Scone/Cookie Bag' items since photo 4's board had replaced that section with a surcharge notice not present on the other boards.
